Partners sign in from the build step

A partner who reaches the build step signed out sees the sign-in form in place, and lands back on the same step once signed in.

flowchart LR
  A["Build step"] --> B{"Signed in?"}
  B -- "no" --> C["Sign-in, in place"]
  C --> A

The form keeps what the partner typed in the step while they sign in.

The call to make: show the form in place, not on its own page. I recommend in place.
